L&T Arm to Deploy NVIDIA Chips at Chennai Data Centre

Larsen & Toubro's (L&T) arm has secured a large order to deploy NVIDIA chips at a data centre in Chennai. The order specifically involves NVIDIA's B300 GPUs. L&T's shares traded lower following the announcement.
